fluff.overview: Caesar's ongoing program to modernize the Legiones Marianes has extended to conventional infantry formations, with improved equipment and weapons gradually replacing older stockpiles across the Hegemony's auxiliary legions. A centuria, or century, is the Marian equivalent of a company-sized formation. Mechanized wheeled centuries use wheeled transports that offer good road speed and lower maintenance costs than tracked vehicles, well suited to the Hegemony's infrastructure-limited Periphery worlds where supply lines stretch thin. Support troops carry man-portable flamers that project streams of burning chemicals, providing devastating area-effect capability against infantry and structures at the cost of short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank.
